name: Local Competitor & Review Watch

parameters.content:
## Local Competitor & Review Watch

### How it works

1. Scheduled weekly trigger checks if competitor watch is configured and fetches competitor place details via Google Places API.
2. Processes and compares current competitor review data with previous snapshots, generating a digest.
3. Sends a compliance-checked email with the competitor watch digest, or an opt-out notice if needed.
4. Separately, a monthly scheduled trigger computes competitor trends over the last month using logged data.
5. Builds and sends a monthly competitor trend email based on analyzed monthly data.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure Google Places API credentials for place details HTTP requests.
- [ ] Set up Google Sheets credentials with access to competitor snapshots and logs.
- [ ] Configure email sending credentials for competitor watch and trend emails.
- [ ] Adjust scheduling settings for weekly and monthly triggers as desired.

### Customization

Modify competitor place IDs in the 'Build Competitor List' node to track different competitors. Customize email content in 'Build Competitor Watch Email' and 'Build Monthly Trend Email' nodes to reflect desired messaging.

## Weekly trigger and conditions

Initial weekly schedule trigger that checks if competitors are configured and branches processing accordingly.

## Fetch and parse competitor data

Builds the list of competitor place IDs, fetches their details from Google Places API, and parses the API response.

## Compare competitor snapshots

Reads the last competitor snapshot from Google Sheets and computes movement compared to the latest fetched data.

## Generate and send weekly digest

Drafts the weekly competitor watch digest or a setup-needed notice and builds the watch email for compliance checks and sending.

## Email sending and opt-out handling

Sends the competitor watch email or skips sending if the recipient opted out.

## Log competitor snapshots

Logs the latest competitor snapshot data to Google Sheets for record keeping and later monthly trend calculation.

## Monthly trend analysis and email

Separate monthly scheduled workflow segment reading full competitor logs, computing monthly trends, building and sending monthly trend emails.

nodes.name: Every Monday at 8am Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs weekly, Monday 8am by default.

nodes.name: If Competitors Are Configured
nodes.notes: Checked here, while there's still guaranteed exactly one item from the trigger -- an unconfigured COMPETITOR_PLACE_IDS routes to a setup-needed notice instead of the run silently dying at zero items.

nodes.name: Build Competitor Place ID List
nodes.notes: COMPETITOR_PLACE_IDS is the entire tracking list -- a semicolon-separated 'Firm Name|Place ID' pair per competitor.

nodes.name: Fetch Google Place Details
nodes.notes: Runs once per competitor from the list above. Needs a Google Cloud project with the Places API enabled and a valid API key -- Google's monthly free credit covers light use of this template.

nodes.name: Parse Place Details API Response
nodes.notes: Reads context back from 'Build Competitor List' by name, not $json, since this node's own $json is the raw Places API response.

nodes.name: Read Latest Competitor Snapshot
nodes.notes: Reads every prior snapshot logged for any competitor -- filtered down to each competitor's own most recent row in the next step.

nodes.name: Calculate Weekly Competitor Movement
nodes.notes: Reads current fetched data from 'Parse Place Details Response' by name, not $input, since this node's own input is the prior-snapshot Sheets read.

nodes.name: Draft Weekly Competitor Digest
nodes.notes: One line per competitor, noting review velocity and rating movement since last check.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { competitor_count: 0, digest_content: '(no competitors configured yet -- set COMPETITOR_PLACE_IDS in n8n Variables)', competitors: [] } }];

nodes.name: Draft Setup Needed Notification
nodes.notes: Fires only when COMPETITOR_PLACE_IDS is empty.

nodes.name: Build Weekly Competitor Email
nodes.notes: Falls back the recipient to FIRM_FROM_EMAIL if FIRM_MARKETING_EMAIL isn't set.

nodes.name: Execute Compliance Workflow
nodes.notes: This template inherits OPS1 per its ticket, even though the recipient is firm staff, not a client -- the opt-out/disclaimer checks are effectively inert here, but the audit log entry is still valuable for consistency.

nodes.name: If Digest Email Approved
nodes.notes: Mirrors the guardrail's approved/opted-out result.

nodes.name: Send Weekly Competitor Email
nodes.notes: Reaches back to 'Build Competitor Watch Email' by name, not $json, since the guardrail call in between replaces $json with its own response.

nodes.name: Skip Email - Recipient Opted Out
nodes.notes: Rare for an internal marketing recipient, but respected the same as any other opt-out check in this catalog.

nodes.name: Append Competitor Snapshots To Sheets
nodes.notes: One row per competitor, every week -- this is the history next week's comparison reads from. Runs in parallel with the digest email, not gated behind it.

nodes.name: Monthly Competitor Trend Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs monthly, the 1st at 8am by default.

nodes.name: Read Full Competitor Log Sheet
nodes.notes: Reads every logged snapshot for every competitor, across all weeks.

nodes.name: Calculate Monthly Competitor Trend
nodes.notes: COMPETITOR_TREND_LOOKBACK_DAYS controls the window — defaults to 30.

nodes.name: Build Monthly Competitor Email
nodes.notes: Internal marketing summary — no guardrail wrap needed, matching this catalog's other trend rollups.

nodes.name: Send Monthly Competitor Email
nodes.notes: Internal, firm-wide summary — no guardrail wrap needed.

description: Runs weekly: for each configured competitor (by Google Place ID), fetches current review count and rating via the Places API, compares against last week's logged snapshot to compute review velocity and rating movement, drafts a plain-English digest, and emails it to the firm's marketing contact through the Bar-Compliance Guardrail. Logs this week's snapshot for next week's comparison. Separately, a monthly rollup reports the longer-horizon trend per competitor. Tracks review count and rating only -- not search ranking or ad presence, which require paid SEO/ad-intelligence tools. Replaces SEO and ad-intel tools for this specific use case.
